notes.title: Free demo coming soon! Team K's latest work is scheduled for April 28th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42670895/e43472dd1736dac0d6d2437e55a7fdb8fb0b8fbd.png[/img]

Hi, gentlemen.
The latest work from the team of "to be or not to be" and "Lost: Find" from a friend - "Build the Garden of Easden" " will be officially released on [u][b]April 28[/b][/u]! This time, the Team K team once again brought a demo to the gentlemen for everyone to experience.
"Build the Garden of Easden" "is a brand new work that is different from the previous game types of DSGAME. This work adopts the theme of traveling through different worlds with elements of cultivating immortals. In terms of gameplay, it chooses the Roguelike auto chess game that emphasizes both strategy and leisure. Players will play the young master of the Acacia Sect in the world of cultivating immortals, and meet girls from different worlds with different personalities and backgrounds. , Start a big adventure in a different world harem!

If you are interested in the gameplay, plot or art style of this work.[b][u]Please add this to your wishlist.[/u][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2356360/_/

Please note: the trial demo does not represent the final quality of the game! The core gameplay, plot context, and art style of the trial demo are basically the same as the official version, but the project team is still stepping up the final optimization of each module, hoping to present better effects for gentlemen in the official version!

notes.title: Two new games coming soon
notes.content:
Hello gentlemen, this time I would like to bring you two new trailers, "Lunar Mirror: The Pavilion of Desire" and "Lovelorn sanatorium III", both of which are the sequels of the previous games. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2157680/_/
"Lunar Mirror: The Pavilion of Desire" is a derivative work of "Lunar Mirror". It tells the story of an ordinary college student in a remote archaeological school who was abandoned by his girlfriend, joined the school's mysterious party, and met different people. The story of a girl who is finally tempted into the abyss. There are also a large number of mini-games in the game for players to experience.
You thought that you would be like the protagonist, who would retreat after discovering all the secrets, but you are actually just an ordinary passerby, and you will only walk towards the trap that has been prepared for you step by step with hope...
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2307120/_/
"Lovelorn sanatorium Ⅲ" is the continuation of the Lovelorn sanatorium series. The game continues with the game setting of the Bitter Lord series. What strange cases will the protagonists Zhang Ji and Jibotu encounter this time.
The game adopts a dynamic comic performance method, with rich pictures and simple gameplay. It cooperates with the mini-game puzzle-solving gameplay to bring players a new and unique experience. The overall story plot is humorous and contains many popular hot spots.
Not much to say, gentlemen, please add to the wish list. There will be a reminder when the game is released, and there will be a 10% discount for the first release of the game. Don't miss it!

notes.title: Lunar Mirror will be officially launched on Steam EA on January 19
notes.content:
Hi, gentlemen
we decided to officially launch "Lunar Mirror" on steam EA on January 19. The EA version of "Lunar Mirror" will contain all the contents of the first chapter. you can experience it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910790/Lunar_Mirror/
"Lunar Mirror" is a horror puzzle game with amazing elements. A sudden astronomical anomaly led to the disappearance of students one after another, and a mysterious society that is happy with love is quietly rising again. What is the connection between your missing girlfriend and them? With the deepening of the investigation, the history of the campus slowly surfaced, but the truth became more complicated

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42201006/6bbd18e40fc565f1a631f76cddf2f340ed307f27.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Why are the girls missing in school
[*] Why are boys keen on midnight activities organized by clubs
[*] What happened ten years ago? Why did the school move to the barren mountains
[*] What kind of conspiracy is the mysterious rising society planning on campus
[*] Religion with childbearing as its theme, combined with horror elements and stunning stimulation, brings new sensory experiences.
[/list]
[h2][b]Note: Friendly tips. First of all, this game is a horror game, followed by the feature content. The game contains thriller elements, so buy carefully!!![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42201006/cab015c56cf43adcffd9902aa8c20f164e2a3f3b.gif[/img]
At the same time, I am sorry that the development progress has been delayed again and again due to the current downward environment and the influence of COVID-19 on team members. Finally, we have to let the game meet with all players in EA mode. I hope that everything will be smooth in the new year and the full picture of the game will be shown to all players as soon as possible.
Finally, I wish you a happy new year in advance
——Mirror of the Moon development team

notes.title: Lunar Mirror 2023.1.13 finalized
notes.content:
Hi, gentlemen
Due to various reasons, the release date of "Lunar mirror", which has been delayed for a long time, has [h2]finally been confirmed! The game will be officially launched on the afternoon of January 13, 2023![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910790/_/
"Lunar Mirror " is a horror, suspense and decryption game with the theme of Cthulhu on campus. Nishimura Qiren's girlfriend mysteriously disappeared on campus. With the help of his friends, Qiren discovered that the disappearance of his girlfriend was linked to the school's weird clubs that are keen on organizing "late night fellowship". As the investigation deepened, strange events happened one after another. , The huge conspiracy behind it also slowly surfaced...
If you can't wait to experience it first, the demo is now on the game store, and you can download and play for free.

[h2]At the same time, let's preview that "Lunar Mirror: The Pavilion of Desire" will also be launched soon![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2157680/_/?curator_clanid=34942634
This game is a derivative work of "Lunar Mirror", telling the story of how mysterious religions develop believers through societies. The gameplay is the same as that of Lunar Mirror which complements some of the story settings of Mirror of the Moon. If you like this type of game, please add it to the wishlist first.

notes.title: "Lovelorn sanatoriumⅠ"COMING SOON
notes.content:
hi gentlemen
This time, we bring you a new work, "Lovelorn sanatoriumⅠ", which is also the first work in the "Lovelorn sanatorium" series!
This is a role-playing game with a dynamic comic narrative. It tells the story of a boy who stumbles upon his girlfriend's secret, causing the relationship between the two to break down and receiving assistance from a rescue center.
The game is simple in operation and rich in screen performance. It restores the frustrations in love in a light and mocking way.
The game will be online in November, and it is now possible to add the game to your wishlist.
